name: v26.2-1
body:
## What's Changed
* Update to Minecraft 26.2 and upgrade Fabric Loader, Loom, Baritone, Minescript, and Catppuccin theme addon
* Add **AutoBrush** - automatically brushes suspicious sand and gravel
* Add **FollowTrader** - makes the trader follow you by hiding the trade screen
* Add **InventoryOrganizer** with per-slot rules (Simple item lists or Advanced Starscript expressions), execution modes, and a dedicated rule editor
* Add **Walkerist** - queue-based pathfinding with the vanilla A* PathFinder, waypoints, door opening, cleanup, logging and rendering, and a `walkerist` command to manage the queue
* **ItemSucker**: add new Walkerist movement mode (now default) and improved return-to-origin
* Introduce **Filterist** - adds an `item` variable to Meteor's Starscript for matching items by id, count, and NBT/data components, plus a `filterist` command to test expressions
* Replace old NBT path/regex filters in **AutoTrade** and **SlotClick** with Starscript expressions
* Add held-item whitelist/blacklist filtering to **ZKillaura** and **ZAimbot**
* Add a **Keybinds** tab with a full keyboard/mouse overview
* Add two new HUD elements: `keybinds` (occupied Meteor/vanilla keybinds) and `minescript-scripts` (running Minescript jobs)
* Add a brand-new module config preset system with a dedicated presets screen
* Add custom Meteorist category colors applied via new GUI mixins
* Rework **AutoCrafter** whitelist matching and drop the `use-first-matching-variant` setting
* Fix minor issues in `RangeActions`, `AutoSleep`, `BoatControl`, `DmSpam`, `InteractCommand`, `Instructions`, `PlayersInfoCommand` and others
* Overhaul the website with a new design, module/command/HUD browser, and changelog section + rework `MeteoristInfoParser`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/compare/v26.1.2-1...v26.2-1
